Story Title: ZOMBIE OUTBREAK: I Built a Cabin on a Window-Washing Platform and Watched the City Die | Creepypasta

A grounded survival horror story set during a brutal zombie outbreak in a fog-choked city. When toxic yellow fog turns the streets into a kill zone and the tower fills with infected, window washer Ronan Granger locks himself onto a suspended platform forty floors up and turns it into a sky fortress. Every move he makes is about height, silence, and staying above the fog. Expect vertical survival, practical problem-solving, and quiet dread: fortifying the rig, rationing food and water, running a wood stove, and staying above the fog line while sprinters hunt inside the building.

What’s inside:
– Fortifying a window-washing platform into a sealed sky bunker
– Toxic yellow fog rules, height advantage, sprinters vs slow walkers
– Heat, water, hygiene, and battery backup on a hanging rig
– Rescue runs through mechanical floors and louver corridors

snippet.description:
Story Title: ZOMBIE OUTBREAK: I Turned a Lifeguard Tower into a Safe Haven and Stayed Above the Dead | Creepypasta

A slow-burn survival horror / creepypasta set during a zombie outbreak. When the streets lock up and the dead start moving in packs, Callum Reddick, a stormwater/drainage inspector, escapes the suburbs and heads for an off-season beach. An abandoned lifeguard tower becomes his only defensible shelter: one way up, long sightlines, and enough room to turn into a real safehouse. He boards the windows, pulls the ladder, rigs a hoist, builds heat and clean water, and keeps strict control at the door while strangers keep showing up after spotting light and smoke. Expect a grounded, “quiet works” survival vibe: light and smoke discipline, water collection and boiling, rationing, watch rotation, and hard calls at the ladder when strangers show up.

What’s inside:
– Fortifying a lifeguard tower: boards, ladder control, hoist setup
– Heat, water, hygiene, rationing, and quiet routines
– Door decisions: letting people talk vs. letting them in
– A major siege test with firearms and consequences
– Realistic survival procedures in a bleak coastal winter
